I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much and is too heavy for my small plot of less than half a hectare. I will spread two cartloads of cow manure on this land before planting, and I will use the maize seed I saved from my own harvest last year. My family will work about fifteen days on this plot, and I will pay a young man for three days to help with the heavy clearing at the start because I am too old for that work now.
